articleTitle: DC-DC Converter for High-Voltage Power Take-Off System of Solar Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: An analysis of the work of a photovoltaic station on the basis of hybrid photovoltaic module based on solar cells modules is carried out. The identified drawbacks suggest a power take-off scheme based on the boost converter (step-up converter). The principle electric circuit of an adjustable bridge resonant enhancer with digital control is developed, which ensures reliability of work, quickly and accurate maximum power point finding and conversion efficiency up to 0.956. The implementation and testing as a part of the photoelectric station was carried out.

articleTitle: SRM Identification with Fractional Order Transfer Functions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper deals with the substantiation of the topicality of the problem of the creation of the high-quality and relatively simple control systems for electric drives with Switched reluctance motor (SRM) due to the continuous increase of the field of application of SRM in industry. The mathematical simulation method with the application of Matlab System Identification toolbox was used to determine that the sufficient convergence of the results can be obtained at the identification of SRM with a fractional rational transfer function having three zeros and four poles, R-squared value for this variant makes 86%. Such a high order of the transfer function of SRM causes the complexity of its regulator design. The authors worked out a method for the identification of SRM fractional measured transfer function based on the use of FOMCON MATLAB Toolbox. This approach provides higher accuracy of SRM identification. R-squared value for the proposed method makes 94 - 96%, which allows the simplification of the controller structure and the improvement of the accuracy of SRM control in the closed-loop control system. It is shown that the structure of the fractional measured transfer function, identifying the process of SRM start, does not depend on the electric drive inertia moment.

articleTitle: Optimal Request Signals Detection in Cooperative Surveillance Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents a synthesis of the optimal request signals detector in aircraft responders of Cooperative Surveillance Systems when the request channel streams of request signals emitted both in the main and side lobes of the requester antenna, deliberate correlated interferences imitating request signals and chaotic impulse interferences and shown that the detection of request signals in an aircraft responder is significantly dependent on the intra-system interference flux density, which reduces the safety of these systems due to the possibility and control the operation of the aircraft of the respondent interested party by the inclusion of intentional correlated interference.

articleTitle: Sleep Stages Classification in a Healthy People Based on Optical Plethysmography and Accelerometer Signals via Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel automatic classifier of rapid-eye-movement (REM), non-rapid-eye-movement (NREM, combined light and deep sleep stages (SS)), and wake stages based on wrist photoplethysmography and wrist 3-axis accelerometer data. The quality and robustness of the classifier are achieved by a multilevel learning framework, which consists of features extraction, preprocessing, signal treatment, machine learning, and post-processing modules. Subject-specific Z-score normalization and exponential smoothing are applied to reduce intra-subject and inter-subject variability. The novel features are based on heart rate variability and motion statistics. Leave-one-subject-out cross-validation technique is applied to estimate the quality of the model. Our solution, based on linear discriminant analysis (LDA), shows the Cohen's Kappa coefficient of 0.58 and accuracy of 77 % for the four class (wake, REM, light, deep) classification problem and Cohen's Kappa coefficient of 0.67 and accuracy of 85 % for the three class (wake, REM, NREM) classification problem. Comparison of different ML algorithms, like LDA, support vector machines, and random forest is done. The obtained results of sleep stages classification exceed the analogous state of the art solutions.

articleTitle: Ouput Voltage Stabilization Process Simulation in Generator with Hybrid Excitation at Variable Drive Speed
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The axial flux hybrid excited generator with ability to change the main flux is considered in the paper. A mathematical model of electrical generator in the rotor coordinate system was obtained to simulate transients and processes of stabilizing the voltage at variable drive speed. An axial flux hybrid excited generator prototype was tested and the experimental results were compared with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Improving Noise Immunity in Identification Friend or Foe Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of enhancing noise immunity in Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) systems. It consists in successive transition from servicing individual request signals to servicing individual interrogators by allocating synchronous sequences of request signals in an aircraft responder, thus making it possible, firstly, to exclude uncorrelated request signal sequences from servicing and, secondly, to significantly reduce the intensity of servicing correlated request signal sequences. The comparative quality analysis of air object identification shows that the IFF systems based on the proposed method have a higher noise immunity compared to the currently used ones.

articleTitle: Formation of High-Voltage Pulses with Nanosecond Fronts in Low-Impedance Loads
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The results of physical and mathematical modelling of the processes of sharpening of electromagnetic waves as they propagate along a forming line (FL) on nonlinear capacitors are presented. The nonlinear dielectric properties of the MLCCs of X7R type were investigated at their operation in non-standard modes with application of voltages up to units of kilovolts. The possibility of these capacitors usage as a working medium for pulsed power generators with sharpening FL is shown.

articleTitle: Principles of Designing and Functioning of the Expert System of Assessing the Efficiency of Introducing Energy Conservation Measures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper deals with the improved method of assessing the efficiency of introducing the energy conservation measures that consider the features of the projects on energy saving and the change of the cash value with time comparing to the existing ones. Moreover, the additional criterion of breakeven allows determining the first priority of modernization. The suggested realization of the expert system of assessing the efficiency of introducing energy saving measures automatizing the process of taking decisions relating to the determination of the most effective option of the building modernization.

articleTitle: Speaker’s Voice Recognition Methods in High-Level Interference Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The statistical and combined methods of identifying the speaker's voice based on the pitch frequency in high-level interference conditions have been developed. Determination of informative spectral components of a speaker's useful audio signal in conditions of text-dependent and text-independent identification has been conducted. The estimation of effectiveness of implementing the developed methods through the use of statistical decision-making procedures and classifying the parameters of feature space of identification objects has been formed.

articleTitle: Image Microstructure Estimation Algorithm of Heterogeneous Materials for Identification Their Chemical Composition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The search for new methods of materials quality control, based on the study of their microstructure, is one of the urgent tasks in the modern world. Development in the field of information technologies and machine learning allowed analyzing the images obtained during a nondestructive control method. In this work the architecture of convolution neural network for image analysis of steel microstructure has been offered. The network gives the predicted composition of heterogeneous materials. Training and testing of the neural network operability have passed on images set of steel microstructures. The system predicted the percentage of chemical elements entering the studied metal. Good results with accuracy of more than 83% are received. Such results demonstrate the expediency of convolutional neural networks application to study the materials microstructure.

articleTitle: Method of Forensic Analysis for Compromising Carrier-lock Algorithm on 3G Modem Firmware
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper, a new method of usage forensics memory analysis for compromising the carrier-lock algorithm was proposed. The firmware of one popular 3G modem for security issues is investigated. A binary file is reverse engineered using IDA Pro Disassembler and the carrier-lock code algorithm is found. The reproduction of arithmetic and bitwise ARM commands under the IMEI to obtain the unlock code by way of just reverse engineering become impossible because of the algorithm complexity. Therefore the existed ARM code was used to generate the unlock codes on the fly via memory forensics technique and JTAG debugger. A new method was successfully tested on a set of different modem versions.

articleTitle: Vector Control of Field Regulated Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: System of vector control the speed of rotor of field regulated reluctance motor with during the action of parametric perturbations is presented in paper. In order to provide robust vector control are synthesized the control algorithms the speed, components of the stator current and the excitation current on the basis of the concept of the inverse dynamics problem in combination with the minimization of instantaneous motion energy functionality. The study of the quality indices of the vector system was carried out using mathematical modeling.

articleTitle: Detection of Rust Defects of Protective Coatings Based on HSV Color Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of segmentation of rusted areas on painted construction surfaces is analyzed. The percentage of rust on the painted coatings can be calculated using methods of digital image processing. Segmentation based on HSV color model is proposed. The basic model of single scale retinex was applied to saturation component for equalization of luminosity, as illumination can have significant influence on the segmentation result. The next step is application of ICM method. The results of segmentation demonstrate that the proposed approach can be effectively used for rust estimation.

articleTitle: About the Possibility of Researching the Optimal Automatic Control System on a Physical Model of a Thermal Object
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article presents laboratory bench for research of the optimal and quasi-optimal automatic control system in the contest of its operation speed. Laboratory bench consists of thermal unit and software and hardware suite which includes VIPA System 200 V and HMI/SCADA logic controller and Zenon Supervisor 7.0 system. Thermal unit is described by differential equation of second order pursuing the control channel “amperage in electric heating unit power converter - air temperature inside thermal unit Differential equation coefficients depend on screen position and rotation frequency of centrifugal blower. The methodology of synthesis and results of calculation of optimal relay hypothesis for thermal unit control through the chosen channel has been approached. The results of experiment in transition of thermal unit from various initial states to final states have been demonstrated. The possibility of implementing optimal control system in respect of its operation speed in real time scale by means of software development by including algorithms for transcendence set of simultaneous equations into it or by means of development of predicative model of thermal unit has been shown.The conditions for application of quasi-optimal relay control hypothesis in respect of its operation speed have been specified. Methodology of synthesis and results of calculation of the length of the first control interval depending on the predetermined value of readjustment has been presented. The results of modeling of quasi-optimal automatic control system in respect of its operation speed in Simulink of Matlab app have been demonstrated. Functional relation of the length of the first control interval depending on the predetermined value of readjustment for implementing of quasi-optimal automatic control system in real time scale with application of basic operational units of programmed logic controller has been established.

articleTitle: Implementation of the Information Resources Protection Based on the CentOS Operating System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This article presents the process of implementing the information security system by using Linux to protect confidential information from the unauthorized influence of intruders. The Unix core protection model was explored. The information communication network was chosen as the object of protection, which is located in the simulated system, based on EVE. Using certain criteria, the optimal software and the virtual hardware were selected. The information and communication network's attacks and tests were implemented by using Kali Linux.

articleTitle: Definition of Accumulated Operating Time Distributions for a Cable Product Insulation Within the Defined Life Cycles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Inappropriate state of cable products in electric power supply lines can cause fire accidents. To be able to foresee cable faults it is necessary to develop an approach for estimating state of a cable on the basis of measurements of current state of its insulation. The paper describes an experiment, where distributions of accumulated operating time for cable insulation within the definite life cycles are defined. In the experiment the grade NAYY-J 4×10 cable was used.

articleTitle: Coil Design for Wireless Power Transfer with Series-Parallel Compensation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The correct choice, calculation and design of the magnetic components of the system is a key factor of the high efficiency of the transmission of energy and reduce the mass-dimensional parameters of the coils. The paper is devoted to optimization of inductance coils for inductive power transfer. The paper compares and selects the shape of the coil and the core, and substantiates required for shielding. The influence of the design of the geometric parameters on magnetic and electrical characteristics of coils is investigated. On the basis of the conducted analysis, coils with and without a ferrite core are developed and simulated, a change in the parameters of the coils in case adding of ferrite coil are shown.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different Spread-Spectrum Techniques for Reduction of Conducted Emissions Generated by Magnetic Resonant Wireless Power Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents comparative analysis of different spread-spectrum techniques for reduction of conducted emissions generated by strongly coupled magnetic resonant wireless power transfer (WPT) systems. The spread spectrum techniques analyzed in the paper are periodic frequency modulation, periodic duty ratio modulation and a combination of them. The analysis is based on computer simulations of the WPT system model created in PSIM environment. The effect of the spread spectrum techniques on the WPT system efficiency is also considered. Obtained results show that frequency modulation outperforms other spread spectrum techniques considered in the paper.

articleTitle: Automated Software Vulnerability Testing Using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper provides a state of current technologies, which are used for automated vulnerability testing in software. Features of fuzzing technology (which is based on making many inputs with different mutated data) are also studied. The essence of the algorithm is the selection of input data, which are more likely to cause a failure or incorrect behavior of the software product. Deep learning algorithms are used to reduce the computational complexity of the testing process. Using a simple fuzzer and Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithm shows that the number of mutations required to detect vulnerabilities is reduced by 30%.

articleTitle: Complexity Evaluation of the Ateb-Gabor Filtration Algorithm in Biometric Security Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The complex estimation of complexity algorithms at application Ateb-Gabor filtration is developed. This filtration is proposed to be used for biometric images. Gabor filtration is a reconstruction of a biometric image multiplying the harmonic function by the Gaussian function. Ateb-functions are an extension of trigonometric functions, and therefore have more functionality. The efficiency of using the Ateb-filter function is shown, which consists of more variants of processed images. Experimental researches of working out filtering time by the developed filter are carried out. The Ateb-Gabor filter contains two rational parameters m and n that allow you to get new values and get new features when filtering. Changing the m and n parameters provides new values for the Ateb-Gabor period, which allows you to extend the number of filter options.

articleTitle: Synchronous Axial-Flux Generator with Hybrid Excitation in Stand Alone Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper deals with synchronous axial-flux generator with hybrid excitation in a stand-alone mode, when the field winding is powered by the armature winding. A mathematical model of electrical machine in the rotating coordinate system was developed to simulate the output characteristics of generator with hybrid excitation in Matlab Simulink. The magnetic losses were taken into account to estimate efficiency of generator. The designed synchronous generator was manufactured and tested.

articleTitle: Analysis of Quantitative Characteristics of Microstructures that are Generated by the Probabilistic Cellular Automata Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Cellular automata method is widely used in the simulation of the microstructure of various materials. The software for the synthetic generation of microstructures of polycrystalline materials has been developed. Using the software, the coefficient of the form, the normalized grain area, the scale factor and the angle of grain orientation are determined. For the obtained data, statistical processing and probability density functions have been obtained. According to statistical parameters, the comparison of the obtained results with the parameters of microstructure of pure iron has been performed.

articleTitle: Passive HF Doppler Radar for Oblique-Incidence Ionospheric Sounding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A multi-path multi-frequency passive HF Doppler radar for oblique-incidence sounding the ionosphere, that has been produced in collaboration between researchers at the Harbin Engineering University and V. N. Karazin Kharkiv National University, is briefly described. An original software package has been designed, and the implemented autoregressive spectrum analysis gives a root-mean-square Doppler line error of 0.02 Hz and 7.5-s time resolution. The radar has been tested over the course of several months in an ionospheric dynamical process monitoring mode.

articleTitle: Advantages of Using a C-band Phased Array Feed as a Receiver in the Sardinia Radio Telescope for Space Debris Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The population of space debris is continuously growing and it represents a potential problem for satellites and spacecraft. In fact, new collisions could exponentially rise the number of debris and so the level of threat represented by these objects. To prevent new collisions, the monitoring of space environment is necessary. For this reason, radar measurements are relevant, in particular to observe Space Debris in Low Earth Orbit. In recent years, the Sardinia Radio Telescope, a fully steerable wheel-and-track 64-m antenna, located in Sardinia (Italy), has been used as a receiver in a Pband bi-static radar for space debris monitoring purposes. In this paper the authors investigate the advantages of using a Phased Array Feed in C-band for space debris monitoring (e.g. improved sensitivity and gain, detection of the object trajectory allowed by multiple beams, improvement of the orbit determination of known and unknown debris), as a receiver of the Sardinia Radio Telescope compared to the already used mono-beam P-band receiver.

articleTitle: Study Influence Industrial Frequency Magnetic Field On Capacitive Pressing Sensor for Large Turbogenerator Core Clamping System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper a present results of the experimental study of the influence of the magnetic field of the industrial frequency on the change in the value of the capacity of the core compression sensor was obtain. The sensor is designed for the development of new types of computerized meters of mechanical defects parameters of powerful generators that can operate under strong magnetic fields of industrial frequency. Designed special stand and used it for experimental research. The experimental results of the influence of the magnetic field of the industrial frequency on the elements of the core compression sensor are obtained. It has been established that the introduction of a core compression sensor into a magnetic field of industrial frequency with a magnitude of magnetic induction from 0.1 to 0.6 T changes the value of the measured capacitance to no more than 0.8%.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic Approach to Designing WPT Systems with Accounting for Non-system Interactions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: An electrodynamic model of a wireless power transfer (WPT) system is presented. Relations for determining blocks of a multipole scattering matrix have been obtained. The multipole is put into a one-to-one correspondence with the interacting transmitting and receiving structures of the WPT system. The approach allows to consider the non-system interactions.

articleTitle: Historical Milestones of Electrotechnical Equipment Creation for Active Experiments in the Near-Earth Space by Ukrainian Scientists
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article is devoted to the historical analysis on development and improvement of electrotechnical equipment, which was developed and applied active experiments in the Near-Earth Space and to assess the contribution of Ukrainian scientists in this field.

Author Keywords: active experiments in the Near-Earth Space

articleTitle: The Method of Raising Numbers, Represented in the System of Residual Classes to an Arbitrary Power of a Natural Number
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Methods for implementing integer arithmetic operations of addition, subtraction, and multiplication in the system of residual classes are considered. It is shown that their practical use in computer systems can significantly improve the performance of the implementation of arithmetic operations. A new method has been developed for raising numbers represented in the system of residual classes to an arbitrary power of a natural number, both in positive and in negative number ranges. An example of the implementation of the proposed method for the construction of numbers represented in the system of residual classes for the value of degree k = 2 is given.

articleTitle: Image Classification and Recognition on the Base of Autoassociative Neural Network Usage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of images classification is considered. It is proposed to use the autoassociative neural networks based on the model of successive geometric transformations for this problem solving. The advantages and disadvantages of this approach are considered, as well as ways to improve the accuracy of image classification.

articleTitle: Three Theoremes of the Instantaneous Power Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Three theorems of the instantaneous power theory, which make it possible to explain the nature of electromagnetic processes occurring in three-phase power supply systems in terms of assessing the energy efficiency of systems in question, are formulated and proved.

articleTitle: Fire Hazard Research of Forest Areas based on the use of Convolutional and Capsule Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The scientific and practical problem of detecting fire hazardous forest areas by using deep learning artificial neural networks applied to Camp Fire (California, USA) is considered in the paper. The theory of deep learning neural networks, the theory of recognition multispectral images and mathematical statistics methods are used. A novel solution of the multispectral images recognition method by using capsule and convolutional neural networks applied to Camp Fire area is presented. A comparative analysis of convolutional and capsule neural networks is conducted.

articleTitle: Research of Energy Efficiency of Manipulation of Dimensional Objects with the Use of Pneumatic Gripping Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The process of manipulation of dimensional objects without optimization and with orientation of optimization gripping systems is investigated. The comparative analysis of energy efficiency of transportation of dimensional objects with orientation optimization gripping systems on the basis of vacuum, vortex and Bernoulli gripping devices is carried out. The efficiency of use of a method of optimization of orientation gripping systems on the basis of pneumatic gripping devices is proved.

articleTitle: Experimental Research of Polarization Transfer Functions of Mobile Ground Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents the results of X-band experimental research of polarization characteristics of mobile remote sensing objects and their polarization transfer functions. It proves that polarization of the backscattered signal is not chaotic: it varies along some definite polarization trajectories. Polarization transfer functions depend considerably upon electro-physical properties of an object, but weakly depend on its shape. Consequently, they can be used as an indicator for the material the object is made of.

articleTitle: Committee of SGTM Neural-Like Structures with RBF kernel for Insurance Cost Prediction Task
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A new method for constructing a committee based on the use of a set of SGTM Neural-Like Structures with RBF kernel for solving regression tasks was developed. The use of the RBF kernel for the hybridization of SGTM Neural-Like Structure allows increasing the accuracy of the method, and building a committee on their basis provides results that are more efficient. Modelling of the method occurred on the real data for the task of the insurance business. The numerical values of the accuracy of the method and the speed of training procedures in comparison with the existing ones are given. The highest accuracy of our prediction method in comparison with the existing ones is established. The developed committee can be used for solving various regression and classification tasks in the field of the insurance business. It is focused on solving tasks of the large dimension. Among the possibilities to increase its efficiency is the possibility of the hardware implementation of this committee with the parallelism of processes, when for each data cluster used its processor.

articleTitle: Enhancing QoS and Energy Efficiency of LTE/LTE-U/Wi-Fi Integrated Network Based on Adaptive Technique for Radio Structure Formation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The technique of adaptive formation of radio access network structure are proposed. This method is designed to form a radio access network using the principles of deterministic and stochastic geometry. Using the simulation means, a model of a heterogeneous network LTE/LTE-U/Wi-Fi is developed. This model depending on spatial localization, distribution of user load and coverage Wi-Fi forms the structure of the radio access network LTE/LTE-U. Dependence of throughput, load distribution on each structural element of the network and energy efficiency were obtained.

articleTitle: Nanocomposite Solders: an Influence of un-coated and Au-coated Carbon Nanotubes on Morphology of Cu / Sn-3.0Ag-0.5Cu / Cu Solder Joints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This study is devoted to the effect of minor admixtures of carbon nanotubes and Au-coated carbon nanotubes on the microstructure of solder/copper joints. The paste of solder Sn3.0Ag0.5Cu (known as SAC305) reinforced with 0.001, 0.003 and 0.005 wt.% of nanosized additions has been prepared as solder material. A microstructure of the solidified solder/copper joints was investigated by SEM. It was revealed that admixtures of the carbon nanotubes slow down the increase of the intermetallic layer Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>, formed at the interface solder/copper. This effect was found in all studied uncoated and Au-coated carbon nanoparticles and could be connected with adsorption of nanoinclusions on the surface of grains in course of solidification. A comparison analysis revealed that the most favorable effect was obtained by adding of carbon nanotubes coated with Au to the SAC305 solder paste.

articleTitle: Application of Three-Capacitance Models for Simulation of Partial Discharges in Solid Dielectric Containing Several Cavities
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A circuit simulation of partial discharges in a solid dielectric was carried out. It is shown that the well-known three-capacitance model can be further developed and used to simulate partial discharges in insulation having complex defects. It is shown that it is practically possible to simulate partial discharges in a solid dielectric containing several cavities using a parallel connection of several three-capacitance equivalent circuits. The results obtained can be used for the qualitative assessment of the partial discharge phenomenon, as well as in the educational process for a deeper study of this phenomenon.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control for Buck-Boost Inverter Based on Unfolding Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper an indirect Model Predictive Control (MPC) for the grid-connected buck-boost inverter based on unfolding circuit is presented. The algorithm of the system takes into account the several predictive states with using the state-space model. The values of the passive components were taking into account to eliminate the discontinuous current mode in the inductance, which leads to the correct operation of the control system. The simulation results for buck and boost modes were presented. The control system operates with using different weight coefficients for each mode. The system flexibility allows to obtain the grid current with a high accuracy and with a reduced zero-crossing distortion. The transient process of the system has a small spike in a case of the constant input power and of the constant input current. The MPC is a suitable technique for grid-connected systems.

articleTitle: Criterial Definition of the Limits of Glow Discharge Energy Stability in Welding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article considers the possibility of regulation of high-current DC glow discharge stability in diffusion welding condition (at discharge current 1...20A and gas pressure 2 ... 15 kPa) by means of certain criterion, which combine of burning mode parameters with condition of its transition into electric arc. As a criterion, the ratio of the average voltage at the discharge gap, which is determined by the frequency of an arc breakdowns, is determined by burning voltage of a stable glow discharge was chosen. In condition of an arc breakdowns absence, the value of the criterion approaches the maximum K = 1, with the increase in the frequency of arcs pulses, the value of K is reduced gradually.

articleTitle: Robust Control of Platforms with Instrumentation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The ways to solve a problem of the vector robust parametrical optimization taking into account uncertainties of mathematical models of the controlled plant and coordinate perturbations are given. Basic features of the robust structural synthesis of the system of the considered type are described. Expressions for the determination of optimization criteria are given. Features of the robust structural synthesis for the one-degree-of-freedom and two-degrees-of-freedom control systems are specified. Sensitivity functions by coordinate perturbations are introduced. Some mathematical models are represented. Results of simulation are given. The represented results can be useful for control of platforms with instrumentation operated on moving vehicles of the wide class.

articleTitle: Transparent Land Governance in Ukraine within World Bank Program
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Remote sensing of agricultural land use and land cover is one of the essential objectives of the EBRD project “Supporting Transparent Land Governance in Ukraine''. Within the project investigation on open source solutions has been conducted for obtaining results concerning actual use of agricultural land, as well as other lands, which are actually cultivated land outside the settlements. For this freely available high spatial resolution data from Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical satellites have been preprocessed and used for detecting arable lands, land cover and crop type mapping in Kyiv, Mykolaiv and Lviv regions in 2018 based on different machine learning methods. In the result it was proven that Sentinel data and proposed methods could be use operationally for monitoring land cover and land use in region scale and it's foreseen that the experience of the project will be extended to the whole country in the upcoming years for achieving the goal of transparent land use.

articleTitle: A 2.3-8.2 GHz Room Temperature Multi-Channel Receiver for Phased Array Feed Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We describe the design, fabrication and test results of a multi-channel heterodyne receiver operating at room temperature across the 2.3-8.2 GHz Radio Frequency (RF) band. Such a “Warm Section” (WS) receiver is part of a Phased Array Feed (PAF) demonstrator that is being built for radio astronomy application. The WS receiver is cascaded to the PAF cryogenic section that incorporates an antenna array with low noise pre-amplification stages. The WS receiver consists of four rack-mountable modules, each of which can process eight RF inputs. Four modules are arranged in a standard 19” rack to allow handling a total of 32 RF signals. The modules perform filtering (through four-way switch filter bank) and down-conversion (to the 375-650 MHz IF band). The IF signals are converted to optical through analogue Wavelength Division Multiplexing IFoF (IF over fiber) transmitters incorporated into the WS receiver. The signals are sent through optical fibers to a backend, where they are converted back to IF before digitization by an Analog-to-Digital Unit.

articleTitle: Random S-Boxes Generation Methods for Symmetric Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The main efficiency indicators of cryptographic Boolean functions and vector mappings, which are used as nodes of the complexity in symmetric cryptographic transformations, are substantiated. Methods of heuristic generation of cryptographic Boolean functions and nonlinear S-boxes for symmetric ciphers that meet the established security requirements are investigated. Prospects for further research with the aim of improving heuristic methods for the synthesis of random S-boxes are substantiated.

articleTitle: Signal Flow Graph for Optimizing of Mutual Sensors Reflection in the Multiprobe Microwave Multimeter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article presents evaluation of the influence of sensors number and mutual reflection on the measurement accuracy of the microwave multiprobe multimeter. There was considered and compared different models of mutual sensor reflection in the multiprobe microwave multimeter. There was shown and proved that the model in the form of signal flow graph for gain determination does not necessarily use the rule of non touching loop (the Maison rule), and it can be successfully replaced by the matrix and topological reduction.

articleTitle: Critical Parameter Analysis and Design of the Quasi-Z-Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The quasi-Z-source inverter (qZSI) can operate as a single-stage buck-boost converter with continuous input currents for renewable energy applications. Generally, the inductances and capacitances in the quasi-Z-source networks (qZSn) are assumed to be large enough to obtain constant inductor currents and capacitor voltages. However, the values of the capacitors and inductors may vary in practical applications. Meanwhile, the load conditions and switching frequency can also affect the operation of the qZSI. This paper presents more operation states of the quasi-Z-source inverter (qZSI) in addition to the three desired normal states (i.e., shoot-through states, active states and null states). Through analyzing various operating modes, the critical values of capacitance and inductance considering the load condition and switching frequency for the qZSI in the continuous conduction mode (CCM) and discontinuous conduction mode (DCM) are analyzed. Simulation results are provided to verify the analysis.

Author Keywords: quasi-Z-source inverter discontinuous conduction mode continuous conduction mode

articleTitle: Heat Flux Control in Non-stationary Conditions for Industry Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: For industrial control systems, the advantage of directly measuring the heat flux is that, the controlling the parameters of an object at a temperature, only the consequences of thermal action are recorded. The determination of the heat flux can detect a disturbing effect at the initial stage, predict its state and timely correct the mode of operation of the object. The purpose of the work is to provide control of the heat flux in non-stationary conditions with the use of heat flux sensors and to determine the requirements for industrial measurement equipment. From the theoretical and experimental results follows that the use of a modified sensor always gives a gain in time compared with a standard sensor. For study of non-stationary thermal conditions established requirements for the information-measuring system. Given a practical application example of surface heat flux measurements in non-stationary conditions for the control in the flight conditions of the thermal load on elements of the launch vehicle construction.

articleTitle: Speed Vector Control of Induction Motor With Copper and Iron Losses Minimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper introduces a speed vector control system of induction motor (IM) with minimization of the copper and iron losses. Proposed loss model based method minimizes the most significant losses in the motor: heat losses in the stator and rotor windings and core losses from eddy currents. A new method for the structural realization of this optimal system is proposed. The proposed system differs from typical systems in terms of the reference signal generation method for the direct and quadrature components of the stator current. It enables increased steady-state efficiency, and ensures high transients quality.

articleTitle: Design Embedded System Testbench Based on FPGA and Microcontrollers for TATU Smart Lab as Education Component of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article describes problems of embedded systems testing and development for Industry 4.0 ready system. Test benches based on FPGA and microcontrollers were analyzed. Education components for Industry 4.0 were considered. Embedded systems for Testbench based on FPGA and microcontrollers for TATU Smart Lab were designed. Testbench with several systems for training were proposed. The idea of combining different systems in one Testbench was successfully implemented.

articleTitle: Control System of Discharge-Pulse Installation with Elements of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The intellectual automated control system, based on inverse fuzzy-models, was developed for the discharge-pulse installations. The neural network controller was used for membership function parameters correction in a process of operation. Also a rule base is dynamically synthesized using a neuron network.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Pseudoinverse Model-Based Control of an Uncertain SIMO Memoryless System with Bounded Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The adaptive robust control of the uncertain memoryless discrete-time system having single control input and many outputs with unmeasured but bounded disturbances having possibly unknown bounds is addressed in this paper. Two so-called pseudoinverse model-based controllers whose parameters are updated via some adaptation algorithms are proposed to deal with parametric and nonparametric uncertainties. The asymptotic properties of these controllers are established. To support the theoretic study, simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: A New Image Enhancement Technique Based on Adaptive Non-linear Contrast Stretching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of creating new methods of image enhancement in automatic mode focused on use in mobile and wireless applications. This work aims to increase the efficiency of image enhancement through intensity transformations. To achieve this aim, we propose a new approach to enhance the images based on an estimate of the cumulative distribution for the sub-ranges of the brightness scale. To demonstrate the capabilities of this approach, proposes a new image enhancement technique by parameter-free intensity transforming. The proposed technique allows to effectively increasing the contrast of complex images without the appearance of unwanted artifacts. The results of experimental research using no-reference metrics and expert estimates of image contrast indicate the effectiveness of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Application of Resistance Welding Machines for Production of Precision Aluminium Joints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Electric resistance butt welding of aluminium alloys through thin metal interlayers has been investigated. The effectiveness of using not high capacity resistance welding machines for getting of precision joints has been shown. The technology of resistance butt welding of aluminium alloy 6063 through thin multilayer intermediate layers of aluminium 1050 foil has been developed. The results of microstructure and mechanical strength analysis have been shown.

articleTitle: Surface and Bulk Wave Modes of Two Dimensional Photonic Crystal Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Electrodynamical characteristics of the two dimensional photonic crystal waveguide are considered. Effect of the width of hollow waveguide channel on the dispersion characteristics and spatial distribution of electric field is analyzed. Slow wave localized modes with phase velocity less than speed of light are supported by photonic crystal waveguide and can be use for synchronization with linear electron beams in the terahertz beam-wave systems. Widening of the waveguide hollow channel does not result in significant decrease of the electric field intensity on the axis of waveguide as occur in metallic slow-wave systems.

articleTitle: Center Weighted Median Filter Application to Time Delay Estimation in Non-Gaussian Noise Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A task of time delay estimation using two or more sensors that receive and process noise-like wideband signals embedded in spatially uncorrelated noise can be treated as classical. A problem arises if environment noise is non-Gaussian and has heavy tails. Then, due to several factors, probability of appearing abnormal elementary time delay estimates can be large, especially if conventional method of cross-correlation signal processing is applied. Different methods to cope with the problem have been proposed including the use of robust DFT at initial stages. However, this reduces computational efficiency of processing radically. Here, we propose a specific modification of classical processing that presumes pre-processing of noisy received signals using center weighted median filter. We show that this easy and fast step allows providing better performance than procedures based on robust DFT. Considerable reduction of abnormal error probability is observed and the method can operate in conditions of limited a priori information about characteristics of additive non-Gaussian noise.

articleTitle: An Optimal Concepts for Aggregation of Data in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper propose an several concepts for optimal algorithm of aggregation of data in wireless sensor network. Given analysis of problems for information aggregation in wireless sensor network. Proposed optimise of structure the node and given basic concepts for reducing energy consumption. Also proposed network partitioning into piconet with next clustering. In final proposed are two modifications for ant algorithms to optimize data collection in wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Traffic Engineering Fast ReRoute Model with Support of Policing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the development of the Traffic Engineering Fast ReRoute model with the support of policing features. The novelty of the model is the use of modified flow conservation conditions, which take into account the possibility of limiting network traffic (Traffic Policing) with its probable overload caused by both increasing network load and the introduction of resource redundancy to provide fast rerouting with bandwidth protection. Innovations also touched on the optimality criterion of routing solutions aimed at both balanced using of the network resource and load limitation in accordance with the priority of flows that transmitted to the edge routers of the network. In the numerical example, the operability of the model and the adequacy of the results obtained on its basis have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cloak Modeling for Complex Shape Radar Target
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Radar detectability reducing for complex shape military or civil object is very important problem of contemporary radar theory. Solution of this problem is unthinkable without providing numerical estimations of the investigated object Radar Cross Section (RCS) and its reduction with some cloak. In this paper a new method for the semitransparent cloak modeling is proposed. This method is realized in the framework of Shooting and Bouncing Ray (SBR) method. General stages of SBR method and the cloak modeling introduction into its algorithm are discussed. The proposed approach was tested on an example of complex shape object.

articleTitle: UWB Signal Processing for the Road Pavements Assessment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A series of laboratory experiments on sensing plane-layered media using pulsed GPR with different antenna unit was carried out. Experiments have shown that when the operator processes the sensing data of even relatively simple media (with the minimum number of layers), the relative error in determining the thickness of the layers can be quite significant. This confirms the importance of conducting a thorough initial calibration of the GPR antenna unit and accurate adherence to the measurement procedure. Under certain conditions, correction factors or the functions specified analytically or in the form of tabular values obtained as a result of preliminary calibration may be additionally used.

articleTitle: Inhomogeneity Inforced Piecewise Smooth Chan-Vese Model for Image Segmetation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Approach to efficient piecewise smooth Chan-Vese model for images segmentation is developed. Computationally effective, robust to initialization and illumination inhomogeneity solution to Chan-Vese model was developed. Proposed approach was tested on synthetic and real images. Experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Vacuum Diffusion Welding of Intermetallic Alloy ɣ-TiAl with High-Temperature Alloy EI437B Through Nanolayered Interlayers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Effect of nanolayered foils on formation of dissimilar joints of γ-TiAl based alloy with high-temperature alloy EI437B was studied. It is shown that application of an interlayer allows producing in the welded joint zone an extended region with a smooth variation of chemical composition in the joint zone.

articleTitle: Building the Quasi One Dimensional Transistor from 2D Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Here we describe some preliminary device results from field effect transistors made from metal trichalcogenides. Although not much investigated, is both promise and room for improvement. Improvements could come from better contacts and lower semiconductor channel defect densities, in metal trichalcogenides transistors. Devices with ohmic contacts have now been fabricated, and the surface termination of these materials modeled by density functional theory.

articleTitle: Medical Tourism Information Support System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper introduces the architecture of the system to support medical tourism. A new model with decision support capabilities to assist medical tourism customers is developed. The analysis of popularity and quality of medical tourist applications are conducted. The information sources used to arrange medical tourism trips are given in the paper. The formation of the user's medical recommendations is based on the information about symptoms of the user, processing of this information, creation / search of the user medical card, search for the coincidence of the user's symptoms with the signs of illness, finding the best treatment option for the user. The system to support medical tourism consists of seven interdependence components: user interface, user profile analysis, definition of the user disease, selection of hospitals and doctors, communication with doctors and tour organization. The system to support medical tourism which provides the user with the all necessary information about the travel organization and medical support is described. Tasks that require further research are defined.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Soft-Switching Current-Fed DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper addresses the methods to retain the functionality of the soft-switching current-fed converter in the case of transistor fault. Various primary-side transistor faults and corresponding scenarios to minimize the influence on the converter characteristics are presented. The proposed method allows preserving the power delivery and converter soft-switching operation in the case of fault of one of the primary side transistors. Post-fault operation was experimentally verified using a 500W converter prototype, and resulting implications for converter efficiency were analyzed.

articleTitle: Color Image Enhancement by Logarithmic Transformation in Fuzzy Domain
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A new fuzzy logic and logarithmic transformation method for enhancing of low contrast color images is proposed. The input RGB image is converted into HSV (Hue, Saturation, Value) color space to preserve the chromatic information contained in the original image. To enhance the image, only the saturation component S and intensity value component V are transformed in fuzzy domain by using S-type membership functions with parameters calculated by solution of the maximum of fuzzy entropy optimization problem. Next, the fuzzy domain is transformed to the logarithmic one. An enhancement of local contrasts by the method of unsharp masking is fulfilled in a logarithmically transformed fuzzy domain for S and V components. After that, a number of inverse transformations is performed: from the logarithmic domain to the fuzzy one and afterwards to the spatial domain. The method of quantitative assessment of quality of color images is proposed. The examples show the effectiveness of the developed method for improving the quality of color images.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithms for Solving Combinatorial Mass Balancing Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A problem of placing discretely distributed masses of objects on fixed locations minimizing the unbalance of the system is considered. The problem is formulated as Euclidean combinatorial optimization one on the permutation set induced by given masses. To solve this problem, original genetic algorithms are offered, for which approaches to a formation of crossover and mutation operators are described. The algorithms are tested on various problems of balancing discretely distributed masses, including those where the objects' rotation is permitted.

articleTitle: Spectral Characteristics of the Titanium Dioxide-Silver Nanoshells Under Localized Surface Plasmon Resonance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In presented work, the spectral characteristics of the titanium dioxide-silver nanoshells under localized surface plasmon resonance have been theoretically studied. It is shown that the spectral position of the surface plasmon absorption peak can be shifted in the given spectral region by changing the core and shell thickness. The influence of deformation shape of nanoshells on its optical characteristics has been researched. The effect of the refraction index of the surrounding medium on the peak position and the intensity of nanoshells plasmon resonance was researched.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Battery-Supercapacitor Energy Storage System for Resistance Welding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a high-efficiency energy storage system within the micro resistance welding device based on battery-supercapacitor semi-active hybrid topology. A SEPIC converter is chosen for energy management between individual energy storages because it can considerably improve Li-ion battery performance in terms of shelf life and increase the overall system efficiency compared to other topologies. Accurate state-space mathematical model of SEPIC converter used within the hybrid energy storage system is obtained by means of average values analysis. It is then used to analyze the overall hybrid energy storage system stability by means of Nyquist stability criterion. The results show that the proposed battery-supercapacitor hybrid energy storage system should be characterized by stable behavior regardless of the variations of duty cycle and load current over a wide range of regimes.

articleTitle: H∞ Robust Control of Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Motors: Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The engineering methodology for the synthesis of a robust AC electric drive control system based on a synchronous electric motor with excitation from permanent magnets with a H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub>-suboptimal speed controller operating in conditions of incomplete information about the object and taking into account its structural uncertainties is considered. It is shown that the use of a robust regulator can significantly reduce the influence of parametric and external disturbances on the regulation quality. Simulation results received in the software package Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Application of Statistical Simulation for Measles Epidemic Process Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Simulation of epidemic processes is actual task, which has high social and economic value. Given research is dedicated to the application of statistical methods to the prediction of the incidence of measles. The structure of the models has been developed. The models show high accuracy.

articleTitle: Retrievieng the Surface Relief of the Smooth Objects by the Digital Holography
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A new method for the surface relief study using digital holography is presented. This method includes an approach for digital refocusing and elimination of optical aberrations. Experimental study of the standard roughness sample allowed estimation of the error of the proposed method. The practical application for solving real tasks of materials science is shown.

articleTitle: Open-End Winding Multiphase Installation Regulated by Modified Techniques of Space-Vector PWM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Novel techniques of space-vector pulse width modulation (PWM) have been disseminated for synchronous adjustment of dual five-phase inverters of open-end winding installation. The proposed PWM techniques have the benefits of symmetrical operation of inverters, and minimization of undesirable voltage subharmonics of the output frequency of systems. The proposed PWM techniques give a good performance of systems in the zone of overmodulation. Modified techniques of space-vector PWM insure voltages symmetry of five-phase dual-converter system with both equal and unequal voltage amplitudes of dc-links, and also for both integer and fractional values of frequency ratio between the switching frequency of inverters and fundamental frequency of the system.

Author Keywords: schemes and techniques of control and adjustment

articleTitle: Optimization of Neural Network Structure for Smart House Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article presents the optimization ways of neural network structure used for automatic devices control in smart houses systems. Presented implementation of the complex system includes a database for sensors data storage, database management system and a module for automatic decision making. Described system usage examples show resolving of actual tasks in common cases of smart homes work.

articleTitle: Diodes with Lateral n+-n -Border
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Diodes with lateral n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-n-border have been proposed as wide-band and high frequency active elements in long part of the terahertz range. They represent planar twoterminal n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-n-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaAs-based structures containing a lateral active border as a n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-n- layer connected to the anode contact. 2-D model of electron movement in the device is considered. The analysis of the diodes operation has been performed using ensemble Monte Carlo technique. The diode characteristics are investigated due to the diode's parameters (n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-n- border position and material doping). The results demonstrate the high frequency generation up to and beyond 300 GHz.

articleTitle: Methods and Means of Knowledge Elicitation in Chinese Image Medicine for Achieving the Tasks of Its Ontological Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The substantiation of a complex of methods and means of knowledge elicitation in Chinese Image Medicine (CIM) for the tasks of its ontological modeling in addition to the development of intellectualized information systems is the topical issue of the article. The methods of specific knowledge elicitation from the CIM experts has been defined in the research, the templates of questionnaires for a group survey have been developed as well, the axiomatic-deductive strategy of the structural and logical organization of the acquired knowledge has been used, according to this data a fragment of the diagnostic ontology of the CIM has been implemented.

articleTitle: Towards Integrating Attribute-Based Access Control into Ontologies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Access control is a security technique that specifies which users can access particular resources in a computing environment. Over the years, numerous access control models have been developed to address various aspects of computer security. In this paper, we focus on a modern approach, attribute-based access control (ABAC), which has been proposed in order to overcome limitations of traditional models: discretionary access control (DAC), mandatory access control (MAC) and role-based access control (RBAC). The work on integrating access control mechanisms in semantic web technologies is developing into two directions: (1) to use semantic web technologies for modeling and analyzing access control policies and (2) to protect knowledge encoded in an ontology. In this paper we focus on the first issue and investigate how ABAC can be integrated into ontology languages.

articleTitle: VHDL Generation of Optimized IIR Filters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper a method is proposed, which consists in integer coefficient searching, forming the filter structure and modeling it. The use of the VHDL language in all steps of the filter design helps to speed-up the design process and to improve the filter optimization. Examples of the multiplier-less IIR filter design show the method effectiveness.

articleTitle: Improved Two-Level Method of Multicast Routing in MPLS-TE Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper proposed the improved two-level method of multicast routing in MPLS-TE network. The original method is focused on implementation of load-balanced multicast routing in accordance with the principles of technology of Traffic Engineering. The method defined the tasks of two hierarchical levels: solution of the routing problem (lower level) and prevention of link overload in the MPLS network (upper level). The improvement of method consisting in modification of link overload prevention conditions will provide reducing the number of iterations of the coordination procedure by approximately in 1.5-5 times

articleTitle: Electronic Properties of Al-, Ga-, and In-Doped Armchair ZnO Nanoribbons
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Structural and electronic properties of pristine and In, Al, Ga-doped armchair ZnO nanoribbons have been investigated using first-principles DFT+ U approach, which precisely predicts the band gap. All pristine and edge-terminated armchair ZnO nanoribbons are found to be nonmagnetic semiconductors despite of widths. The band gap decreases monotonically when nanoribbon width increases. Established that edge substitution dopant site is more stable than other dopant sites. From the spin dependent density of states and band structure the half-metallic properties in doped ZnO nanoribbons are observed.

articleTitle: Surface Wave Technique at Millimeter Waveband for Semiconductor Testing by Photoexcitation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A new surface wave technique at millimeter waveband 53-225GHz has been developed for non-contact, non-destructive testing of semiconductors using photoexcitation. Both positive and negative signal polarities are observed for semiconductor samples and metal-semiconductor structures. The scheme of experimental setup is presented. Preliminary experimental results are illustrated and discussed.

articleTitle: Smart Control of Multi-zone Object Heating with Multi-source System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of maintaining the temperature parameters of a multi-zone object is considered by the example of heating control in the Smart Home. The task of modeling and researching a system with several sources of heat energy is being solved. The aim is to improve the quality of maintaining temperature parameters. The possibility of transition from oscillatory mode to stationary is explored.

articleTitle: Estimation of Smart Home Thermophysical Parameters Using Dynamic Series of Temperature and Energy Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A development of the modern methods dedicated to the energy optimization systems for a smart home is being widely studied by community of academic researches and commercial R\&D facilities. To contribute a new method to the existing approaches designed for the understanding of smart home energy losses caused by environmental conditions, an algorithm for estimation of the thermal parameters of the smart home is presented in this paper. Proposed method is based on solving an inverse thermophysical problem in variational formulation, where the temperature and energy data are used as input parameters. This type of problem has been obtained by a reduction of the differential form of a dynamic heat transfer equation to discrete representation in order to use sensor time series data. The realization and testing of developed method has been carried out by using an open-access dataset provided by REFIT SMART Home project. These smart home sensor data have been undergone a cleansing with the subsequent matching with discrete form of the heat transfer problem. Finally, as a result of this process, the effective thermophysical parameters - heat capacity and conductivity have been calculated with the use of solving the inverse problem by one of the state-of-art minimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Dynamic Regularization Parameter optimization of a Sample Estimate of the Correlation Matrix of Observations by the Criterion “Computational Stability-Consistency”
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of choosing the optimal dynamic regularization parameter of the maximum likelihood (ML) estimate of the correlation observation matrix is solved. An algorithm is obtained for calculating the optimal parameter of dynamic regularization in the sense of the “computational stability - consistency” criterion of a sample estimate of the correlation matrix under conditions of a priori uncertainty about its spectral composition. Positive properties identified and the advantage of optimizing the dynamic regularization parameter of a sample estimate of the correlation matrix is shown. The application of the optimal regularization algorithm to the problem of detecting an echo signal at the output of an adaptive antenna array in a nondeterministic clutter and jamming environment is considered.

articleTitle: Use of Modified BM3D Filter and CNN Classifier for SAR Data to Improve Crop Classification Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Monitoring of agricultural regions is an important task. Recent trends to solve it are based on applying multi-temporal remote sensing in order to obtain reliable crop classification maps. If a radar remote sensing is used, speckle presence in the original data reduces a classification accuracy. A negative impact of speckle can be reduced by image prefiltering procedure. Recent studies carried out for Sentinel-1 imagery have shown that more efficient pre-filtering usually results in better classification. Thus, here we propose a modification of block matching three-dimensional (BM3D) filter adapted to the properties of Sentinel-1 radar data. We demonstrate that its use leads to improved classification of crops in agricultural region of Ukraine compared to earlier methods which are based on other filters. Additionally, a convolutional neural network approach for crop mapping is investigated in this paper for decreasing noise impact and is compared with a traditional pixel-based multi-layer perceptron.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Clustering of Incomplete Data by Means of Similarity Measures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The current standing in the scope of Data Mining considers clustering to be one of the most useful and widely used tools. Multiple real-world datasets usually contain drops/gaps in the data due to various reasons. The currently known approaches are highly efficient only in those cases when original datasets do not change their volumes during the analysis. However, up-to-date problems mostly deal with sequential online data processing. On the other hand, there is no prior knowledge on which feature vectors contain overlooks. In this manuscript, the challenge of possibilistic and probabilistic online clustering approaches for processing incomplete data is solved through similarity measures of a specific kind which are capable of either loosening outliers' influence or repressing them.

articleTitle: A Pattern Logic for a Citizen-Generated Subjective Quality of Life Index in Neighborhoods
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper puts forward a procedure for measuring and analysing the subjectively felt quality of life of citizens in a certain location. Referring to ongoing debates about quality of life in cities, it introduces a systematic approach for performance evaluations of neighborhoods. The presented method suggests tools for constant information collection by way of qualitative surveys regarding georeferenced (local) subjective themes of citizens. Supported by a novel pattern logic, these tools can be flexibly adjusted through iterative steps. Adding to discourses on sentiment analysis, the paper also introduces a semi-automated method for the linguistic clustering of citizen statements.

articleTitle: The Wavelet Based Detecting of the Signalling Relay Armature Defects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of automatic detection defects of armature and contact springs in railway signalling relays. Signalling relays are currently basic components in train control systems that ensure train traffic safety and to ensure their reliable operation, the relays are periodically subjected to routine maintenance. Most of the tests for signalling relays are performed manually, which is time consuming and very expensive. For developing the automatic method for detecting and identifying the relay armature defects the investigations were performed with ten different types of neutral signalling relays. For each type of relay, several groups were formed, which consisted of three relays, in which one group contained fully serviceable and properly configured relays, while the other groups contained relays with some artificially created defects in the form of deformed contact springs or defects in the coil or magnetic core. To identify the features of the basic defects of relays, the time dependence of the transient currents were measured during relay switching on and off. Three segments are clearly distinguishable on the transient current curve: the first segment when the anchor is in the initial position and the magnetic circuit is open, the second one when the armature moves from the initial to the final position, and the third one when the anchor is picked up and the magnetic circuit is closed. In the first and third segments the current in the relay coil increases exponentially with time constants depending only on the impedances of the coil, which allows to use these time constants for detecting defects in the relay coil and magnetic circuit. In the second segment the current in the relay coil is determined by electromechanical processes that occur during the movement of the armature, which include magnetic, friction, deformation forces etc., and defects of moving components lead to a change in the shape of transient current curve and to appearance of some features in the form of sags and swells on it. Du to these features are small, using the wavelet decomposition of the transient current dependences for detecting defects of armature in signalling relays was proposed in the work. For prompt detection of all possible armature defects, to use the wavelet Shannon entropy as an integral parameter, the value of which strongly depends on the appearance of any order disturbances in the systems was also proposed in the work. The effectiveness of the proposed methods have been investigated and obtained results confirmed their effectiveness.

articleTitle: Analysis of Methods Providing QoS for Use in Tactical Mobile Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper, a classification and analysis of the known QoS methods assurance in terms of the feasibility of their application to increase the performance of the tactical mobile radio network are offered. The necessity of developing methods to control of data flows intensity in this network is proved.
