abstract: The article describes a comprehensive synergetic model of steelmaking in arc steel furnaces. This model allows to obtain information on the values of the basic parameters of melting: the active power supplied to the furnace by each phase, the temperature of charge, melt, slag in different places of the working chamber of the furnace, the compositions of melt, slag, furnace atmosphere, the amount of heat absorbed or released as a result of chemical transformations; and is effectively used in the creation of an automated control system of an arc furnace.

articleTitle: Boolean Functions for Stream Ciphers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The possibility of generating a special type of sequence, called de Bruijn sequence, at minimal hardware and software costs to implement nonlinear Boolean functions, and apply them in stream encryption systems, is the main subject of this work. The paper presents the possible structure boundaries (algebraic degree of a Boolean function, the number of monomials in a function) of iterative de Bruijn sequence bitrate generators for various generated sequence characteristics, such as linear complexity and autocorrelation function. The profile of the linear complexity of the studied sequences is closed to the expected value of the linear complexity, as well as for a truly random sequence.

articleTitle: The Effect of Ground Parameters on the Sensitivity of an Active Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this conference paper we briefly describe the technique and present the results of calculations of the sensitivity of an active antenna used as an array element of Giant Ukrainian Radio Telescope (GURT) for various parameters of the underneath ground within 8-80 MHz frequency range. We use for calculations three sets of parameters which correspond to normal, wet and dry ground. We show the modeling results of dipole impedance and absorption area, as well as compare the sky noise dominance (SND) and system equivalent flux density (SEFD) of an active antenna placed above ground with predefined parameters.

articleTitle: Matching the Waveguide-Slot Radiator with the Material Medium
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A calculated and experimental study of the possibility of matching a waveguide-slot radiator with a material medium of an unknown permittivity when irradiated in a chosen microwave frequency range is presented.

articleTitle: Revised Effect of Inductive Voltage Drop Across Line Lead on Protective Level of Surge Arrester
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper connecting lead wires of metal-oxide surge arresters for 330 kV transmission systems are observed. The formula for inductance of two-bundle conductor is proposed and the inductance of connecting lead wire attached to surge arrester was calculated. This formula can be used for 330 kV or 362 kV transmission systems instead of the known value of1.3 microhenry per meter. New formula for the inductance of the connecting lead wires eliminate overestimated value of protective level for surge arresters when bundle conductors are used. The effect is most noticeable for discharge currents with a steep front. The results of surge arrester simulation, which demonstrate this effect, are given. Frequency-dependent model of surge arrester was used for simulation.

articleTitle: System of Active Shielding of Magnetic Field of Power Transmission Lines with Different Spatial Location of Shielding Coil
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A single-circuit robust system of active shielding for magnetic field, generated by group of power transmission lines with different spatial locations of the single shielding coil is given. The synthesis of a robust system of active shielding is based on multi-criteria stochastic game decision, which calculated by multiswarm stochastic multi-agent optimization. It is show, that synthesized system of active shielding reduction the magnetic flux density to the sanitary standards level in a shielding area. Shielding zone size depends on shielding coil spatial arrangement. Field experimental research of the effectiveness of single-circuit system of active shielding of magnetic field generated by group of power transmission lines with different spatial locations of the shielding coil carried out. Comparison of the results of experimental and calculated values of magnetic flux density in the shielding zone shows that their spread does not exceed 30 %.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Simulation of the Structure of the Ukrainian Power Generating Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article deals with the approach to modeling the structure of power generating capacity of power companies in Ukraine. An analysis of the structure of the electric power generating industry has been carried out. The modeling problem is formulated. Theoretical-game model was constructed under fuzzy conditions. It is reduced to the linear programming problem. An example of simulation is considered.

articleTitle: Air Quality Estimation Using Satellite and In-situ Data for Kyiv City within ERA-PLANET Project
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: For evaluating in quantitative manner the progress of achieving the sustainable development goals and how big the progress is, a global indicator framework was developed. In this paper, we propose the approach to the comprehensive Air Quality (AQ) monitoring based on harmonized satellite and in-situ data in the framework of the HORIZON 2020 Project. Within this survey we describe conceptual architecture of the infrastructure to measure, in particular, nitrogen dioxide (NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), carbon monoxide (CO), Particles less than 2.5 μm (PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub>), Particles less than 10 μm (PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>) concentration over the Kyiv city using up-to-date monitoring instruments; we describe requirements for information tools and network for informing Kyiv city community on the state of AQ that will be created on the base of existing AQ monitoring stations. The comprehensive review of in-situ and satellite measurements of atmospheric pollutants is provided as well as the results of validation of global AQ products from Sentinel-5 Precursor (Sentinel-5P) and Copernicus Air Monitoring Service (CAMS) with the use of available in-situ data.

articleTitle: On the Evaluation of Wind Characteristics in a Low-Wind Location Utilizing Weibull Distribution: Case Study of the Lviv Airport (Lviv, Ukraine)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In a most common case, weather data for wind power analysis at a location is analyzed to obtain (1) most probable wind speed (critical fur wind turbine selection) and (2) wind power density (critical for wind power yield analysis). 30-minutes 2000-2017 dataset collected at the Lviv airport (Lviv, Ukraine), was analyzed using Weibull probability distribution that is most commonly utilized fur the wind speed representation. The dataset is an example of a low-wind location; in particular, the dataset contains a couple of years characterized by high zero-wind-speed probability (up to 0.46 in 2006). Weibull parameters were estimated utilizing a variety of the most commonly used methods, as well as Matlab built-in tools for Weibull and Rayleigh (a partial case of Weibull) distributions. The analysis has shown that the maximum likelihood method and Matlab Weibull estimation provide the worst representation of wind characteristics at the location, while other methods provide similar acceptable results if the possibility of zero winds is low. The ener pattern factor method provides the best wind power density estimation. Most probable wind speed for high-zero-wind-speed-probability years is best estimated by Rayleigh distribution, it has been demonstrated that interannual variation of the most probable wind speed (1.5-2 m/s) is insignificant in terms of a wind turbine selection. On the other hand, annual wind power density varies from 8.8 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in 2006 to 15 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in 2002; therefore, one-year or three-year period is insufficient fur wind power yield analysis.

articleTitle: Antenna synthesis based on fractal approach and DRA technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the study combined antennas developed on the basis of dielectric resonator elements and a fractal approach. This approach allows to achieve a broadband and multi-band antenna systems. As a basic structure is considered, composed of a recursive tree and passive dielectric resonators. To simplify the analysis of the characteristics of the proposed antennas, their arrangement is limited by the fractal on the level of the first three iterations, and the number of dielectric resonators does not exceed four. Due to the complexity of describing the interaction of the antennas of non-Euclidean geometry with radio waves for their synthesis and analysis selected methods for the numerical simulation. An evaluation of the spatial-frequency characteristics of the designed antenna solutions used indicators such as return loss, beam pattern and voltage standing wave ratio.

articleTitle: Sub-Microfluidic Setup to Quantify Cell Surface & Charge Density
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to create a prototype of an experimental setup for studying the electrical properties of biological cell surface by measuring electrophoretic mobility of cells and estimating zeta potential. We improved the microscopic method of observing cell electrophoresis in sub-microfluidic chamber with real-time video capture. The basic approaches to the analysis of received video images were figured out in order to correctly determine the linear and electrophoretic velocity of cells for further calculation of zeta potential. Automated processing of obtained experimental data allows faster statistical analysis of distribution of parameters within a cell population. Test measurements on erythrocytes and guidelines for the operation of the device have been developed.

articleTitle: Land Surface Temperature Analysis and Trends for Rivne Using Remote Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: City's ecological monitoring it is a problem with which a lot of city's are faced today. There no one solution that can solve all the problems. This problem include greenery monitoring, city growth monitoring, air quality monitoring, water monitoring and soil monitoring. All this aspects are combined in Nexus approach that have specific for city's use. Remote sensing approach gives applicable data source for city's ecological characteristics monitoring and forecasting. Ukraine can use world experience in remote sensing data. In this work, remote sensing approach was used within the Public initiative “Trees with stories in Rivne”, and it includes the analysis of the condition of urban trees, the land surface temperature for the city, city planning, comparison with the city of Lublin and city's state tends analysis. For this task were used satellite images of Sentinel-2 to build land cover classification maps and vegetative NDVI indices, satellite images of Landsat-8 used to build land surface temperature maps and increase the time series of vegetation index by 2014 for trends calculation. The analysis showed poor condition of green plantations, high summer average land surface temperature and deterioration of these indicators it trends.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Energy Efficiency of the Railgun
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents a new type of the electromechanical rail accelerator, we named the segmented railgun, which is designed to deal with the most important problems of rail accelerators, such as low efficiency, and rails heating. Together with the explanation of the construction and the operating principles, the comparative mathematical modelling of both conventional and improved railguns has been carried out. The listed results of the modelling shows the rise of efficiency and reduction of heating of the rails in the segmented railgun as well as demonstrates its specific properties.

articleTitle: Assessing Enclosure Case Design on Excitation and Transmission of Vibration in Electronic Packages
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper represents research aimed at assessing elastic and dissipation properties of enclosures on excitation and transmission of vibration in electronic packages. Once bearing parts of electronic packages, in particular printed circuit boards, receive resonant oscillations, the dynamic forces increase manifold so that they cause breakages of parts and components. In the paper, three basic problems are in objective for enclosed electronic packages forced by vibration: finding natural frequencies of printed circuit boards using estimation and test methods; assessing enclosure case design on vibration transmission to printed circuit boards installed inside; developing methods and means to reduce transmission and excitation of vibration inside the enclosure case.

articleTitle: Radar Detectability Analysis for Complex Shape Ground Object
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper is devoted to analysis of radar detectability of complex shape object. Data about RCS (Radar Cross Section) of analyzed target were obtained for all azimuth angles (Back Scattering Pattern - BSP) and for most useful view angle ranges with Physical Optics - Shouting and Bouncing Ray Method. Obtained data were statistically processed. Such processing allows obtaining detection probability for the investigated object for radars with different characteristics. Proposed method was tested for an example of complex shape object, namely, tactical armored wheeled vehicle. Developed algorithm can be effectively used for analysis of radar detectability reducing with some cloaking or with geometric changes of the object shape.

articleTitle: Ternary Bitwise Balancing Analog-to-Digital Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper are offered a method, algorithms and structural scheme of ternary ADC with bitwise balancing conversion type in order from the less significant bit to the most significant bit. This method allows to accelerate the conversion process, when the input signal is changing in the narrow bands defined by the specifics of the information sources in the technological control systems. Applying the node to determine the difference between the feedback value from DAC and the input unknown value, which determines the occurrence of this value in the boundary of the unit quantum, allowed the finish of the conversion process with a smaller number of iterative balancing steps. Calculated the parameters of operational complexity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multithreaded Evolutionary Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: There are described different methods of usage of the standard.NET class Task for the creation of multithreaded applications in C#. For instance, to separate the thread which performs expensive calculations from the one, which supports the Windows application's user interface. It is given an example of the usage of described techniques in the application, which solves the traveling salesman problem for a large number of cities using the genetic algorithm. It is presented the results of the experimental performance evaluation of the algorithm, depending on the number of parallel calculation execution threads.

articleTitle: The Synthesis of the Functional Systems Structure by the Example of Liquid Heating Workflow
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper deals with the solution to the problem of the synthesis of the convertor-class functional system with the fractional supply of directed-action products. During the synthesis, at the first stage we solved the problem of providing the possibility for the interactive cooperation of the system objects in the process of the formation of the finished product with the assigned consumer properties. At the second stage of the synthesis we developed the architecture of the module of the system operations identification and the determination of the boundary values of the efficient controls domain. At the third stage we created the module connecting the level of the demand for the final product of the system with the optimal control of its productivity.

articleTitle: Near Zone of Plane Disk with Uniform Transient Current Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The near zone of a plane transient radiator is investigated in Time Domain. The problem is solved by Evolutionary Approach to transient electromagnetic problems converted to a set of Klein-Gordon Equations with definite initial and boundary conditions. The application of Riemann function approach permits to obtain the evolutionary coefficient in explicit form for Heaviside step function excitation case. To generalize the solution for the time dependence of the given current the superposition principle in form of Duhamel integral is used. The energy characteristics in the near zone of the radiator and the formation of electromagnetic wave are investigated.

articleTitle: Properties of Planar Waveguide With Gain (Absorption), Applied on a Glass Prism
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Structure that consists of glass prism, with successively applied two dielectric layers with small and high refractive indices has been analyzed using matrix method. Moreover, the second waveguide layer has complex refraction index. In the case of absorbing layer, for optical waves with certain wavelengths and angles of incidence, the reflection coefficient is equal to zero. In the other case, where the dielectric layer with complex refractive index has amplifying properties, the reflection coefficient at certain wavelengths and angles of incidence becomes significantly high.

articleTitle: Microwave Radiation Transfer to Thin Conductive Fibers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The process of absorption of microwave radiation in thin conductive fibers was researched. We aimed to measure the radiation energy absorbed in the irradiated by microwave radiation thin fibers. In this paper we present the results on strong absorption and scattering of radiation in the fibers with diameters much less then wavelengths. Radiation transfer efficiency in our experiments reached 10%.

articleTitle: Influence of temperature on optical properties of Cd3In2Te6
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The investigation influence of temperature on the optical properties of Cd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> Te<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> was carried out on spectrometer C Φ-2000 within the interval of wavelengths of electromagnetic radiation λ = 0.4 ÷ 1.1 μm. Attachment Pike was used for measuring R. Basing on the dependencies α<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> on the energy of incident electromagnetic radiation it was determined that in Cd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> Te<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> the value of the band gap was obtained, and the direct allowed interband optical transitions occur.

articleTitle: Study of Perspective of Gaseous Dielectric Parameters Monitoring with Use of Coupled Biconical Resonators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The advantages of using coupled biconical resonators for monitoring the parameters of gaseous dielectrics are considered in the paper. In this case, one of the resonators is the reference one. Application of coupled biconical resonators makes it possible to detect deviations of the dielectric constant and loss tangent of the test medium with values of the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> correspondingly.

articleTitle: Difference Between the Concepts of “Competence” and “Managerial Competence” in Terms of Pedagogical Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article presents studies on the definition of terminological concepts competence, managerial competence. In scientific circles there is no single approach to the definition of the structure of competence, its composition depends on what kind of analysis is analyzed. Depending on this, emphasis is placed on those or other structural components. The purpose of our study is to analyze and compare the definition of the concepts of “competence” and “managerial competence”, as well as their scientific and ethical aspects in relation to the training of electrical engineers.

articleTitle: Multi-band Antenna Based on Quasi-Fractal Microstrip Monopole
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The results of the study of the main characteristics of a multi-band antenna based on a microstrip monopole using a quasi-fractal approach in the formation of the radiating aperture topology are presented. The numerical modeling of the spectral content of the excited modes and matching characteristic for dielectric substrates with different permittivity is performed employing the finite elements method. Through a cycle of experimental research, the main features of energy and polarization characteristics have been determined.

articleTitle: Near-Field Homogenization for Trapped Modes in a Cluster-Based Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A cluster-based all-dielectric metasurface sustaining resonant conditions of the trapped mode excitation is studied. We demonstrate that the strong and homogeneous electric near-field can be distributed in-plane of the structure outside the high-refractive-index dielectric particles when the cluster geometry is properly chosen. This effect opens prospects to design highly desirable tunable sub-wavelength metasurfaces that can provide a more efficient employment of materials which exhibit pronounced absorption, nonlinear characteristics or properties of gain media.

articleTitle: Topology and Fractal Dimension of Nanocomposite Metal-Dielectric Films
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Surface topology of silver and gold ultrathin films is studied by means of atomic force microscopy. Films under study comprise metallic phase and insulating (voids) phase, therefore can be considered as metal-dielectric composites. Principal parameters of such structures are estimated depending on film thickness and substrate temperatures. Different types of fractal dimension are determined.

articleTitle: A Non-Linear Regression Model to Estimate the Number of Defects for Software Testing Phase
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Mathematical model, confidence and prediction intervals of multivariate non-linear regression to estimate the number of defects in software developed in Java and PHP for testing phase are built on the basis of Johnson's multivariate normalizing transformation. Comparison of the built model with other regression models based on univariate transformations is performed.

articleTitle: Calculation of Spectral Green’s Function and Its Asymptotical Behavior for Sheet Electric Current in Two-Layer Dielectric Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Structures with patches placed on the interfaces in a two-layered dielectric waveguide are promising to be used in different applications at THz waves. To realize the method of moments (MoM) solution in the spectral domain spectral Green's functions (GFs) for sheet electric currents on the interfaces of the two-layer dielectric cylindrical waveguide are needed. This paper presents the way to enhance the MoM solution efficiency by extracting an asymptotic behavior of the spectral GF which depends on two variables: the propagation constant and the azimuth index. Here asymptotic spectral GFs are constructed and calculated when electrical sheet current is placed on different interfaces.

articleTitle: Directive and Polarization Patterns of Finite-Size Corner Antenna with Circularly Polarized Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Within the frames of the uniform geometrical diffraction theory method the 3D vector problem of radiation of a finite size corner antenna excited by a tilted half-wave electric dipole has been solved and the effective software were developed. The spatial directive and polarization patterns of a corner antenna at optimum sizes as well as at dipole slope angle providing the circularly polarized radiation along the normal to the corner aperture with optimized directive gain are investigated. It is shown that the circularly polarized field takes place also in the angular sector of thirty degrees relative to the corner normal.

articleTitle: Waves Scattering by Graphene Semi-Infinite Grating
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Scattering of the H-polarized electromagnetic waves by the semi-infinite graphene strip grating is considered. The method of singular integral equations is used for solution. Dependences of the scattering and absorption characteristics are represented.

articleTitle: Power Supply of Resistance Welding Machine as Shunt Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: An original approach to application of power supplies for resistance welding machines is offered. It is based on the use of the power supply, based on direct three-to-one phase matrix converters as shunt active power filter. During technological pauses in the operation of resistance welding machines it's power supply can be use as CSI-based active power filter. The DC-link of this filter is the primary winding of welding transformer. Proposed power circuit topology and control system is simulated using MATLAB. The simulation results confirmed high effectiveness of proposed aproach. It became possible to achieve active filter functions from the resistance welding power supply.

articleTitle: Simulation of the ECG Signal Based on the Analysis of the Spectrum of Its Standard Components
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The complexity of the ECG signal as an object for modeling has led to a wide variety of proposed mathematical models that allow solving this problem. However, most of the methods are not applicable to simulation. The proposed solution made it possible to obtain the ECG signal generator as a block of the standard library in the Simulink. This generator can be used as a source of simulation signal in the synthesis of models of devices for processing cardiographic signals and evaluating their effectiveness. The developed module can generate both a normal cardio signal and a signal with specified parameters of specific peaks and segments. Generation of an ECG signal for some types of pathologies has shown the adequacy of the synthesized signal to real cardio signals.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Impedance Distance Relay for Fault Location and Protection of Single Wire Earth Return Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Different technologies and resources are utilized to provide electricity access for the rural population around the world. Single wire earth return (SWER) line gets prominent attention around the globe to electrify low load profile customers and remote load like telecom base stations by extending from the nearby medium grid. SWER distribution system is designed by tapping from medium voltage distribution line using an isolation transformer. Unlike other distribution systems, the secondary side of a transformer has an only single line with dedicated perfect grounding system. SWER lines are considered as a cost-effective solution, compared to the threephase grid extension by electric utility companies. Since line route is mostly in rural areas with different geographical topologies, natural and human-made faults are inevitable scenarios on the line. According to a preference of utilities and geographical locations, SWER lines are equipped with overcurrent relay, surge arrestors or reclosers to isolate faulty line during the fault. The two main challenges on SWER line protection are to back up existing overcurrent protection relay when it fails to clear the fault and to locate the location of fault for line maintenance. Technicians patrol up to hundreds of km along SWER line to locate a fault. This activity will be inefficient and time-consuming way of locating the fault. In this paper, we model and simulate the impedance distance relay to back up existing protection system and locate the fault. Our model successfully backs up definite time overcurrent (DTOC) relay for a single line to ground (SLG) faults across the line. Consequently, fault locator-block locates the faulty line position.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Discrete Complex Nonlinear Signals with Necessary Properties of Correlation Functions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The main information and communication systems (ICS) effectiveness parameters are: reliability, resiliency, network bandwidth, service quality, profitability and cost, malware protection, information security, etc. Most modern ICS refers to multiuser systems, which implement the most promising method of distributing subscribers (users), namely, the code distribution, at which, subscribers are provided with appropriate forms of discrete sequences (signatures). Since in multiuser systems, channels code division is based on signal difference, then the ICS construction and systems performance indicators are determined by the chosen signals properties. Distributed spectrum technology is the promising direction of information security for telecommunication systems. Currently used data generation and processing methods, as well as the broadband signal classes used as a physical data carrier, are not enough for the necessary level of information security (information secrecy, imitation resistance) as well as noise immunity (impedance reception, structural secrecy) of the necessary (for some ICS applications). In this case, discrete sequences (DS) that are based on nonlinear construction rules and have improved correlation, ensemble and structural properties should be used as DS that extend the spectrum (manipulate carrier frequency). In particular, with the use of such signals as the physical carrier of information or synchronization signals, the time expenditures on the disclosure of the signal structure used are increasing and the setting of "optima", in terms of the counteracting station, obstacles becomes problematic. Complex signals obtained on such sequences basis have structural properties, similar to random (pseudorandom) sequences, as well as necessary correlation and ensemble properties. For designing signals for applications applied for measuring delay time, signal detecting, synchronizing stations and etc, side-lobe levels of autocorrelation function (ACF) minimization is essential. In this paper, the problem of optimizing the synthesis of nonlinear discrete sequences, which have improved ensemble, structural and autocorrelation properties, is formulated and solved. The use of nonlinear discrete signals, which are formed on the basis of such sequences, will provide necessary values for impedance protection, structural and information secrecy of ICS operation. Increased requirements for ICS information security, formation and performance data in terms of internal and external threats (influences), determine objectively existing technical and scientific controversy to be solved is goal of this work.The paper presents the results of solving the actual problem of performance indicators improvements for information and communication systems, in particular secrecy, information security and noise immunity with interfering influences, based on the nonlinear discrete cryptographic signals (CS) new classes synthesis with the necessary properties.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Wave Scattering by Pre Fractal Grating of Impedance Strips
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Mathematical models of electromagnetic wave scattering by flat pre-fractal impedance strips grating (FPFISG) are presented. The scattering problem is treated in the classically rigorous formulation on the base of the integral equation technique. A FPFISG consists of impedance strips located within a plane according to segments which form a certain stage of a self similar fractal's creation. The main attention is focussed on mathematical model of electromagnetic wave scattering by sparsely FPFISG, which have an explicit solution.

articleTitle: Longitudinal Electric Field Effect on Multiharmonic Space Charge Wave Formation in Two-Stream Superheterodyne FEL
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We performed the analysis of the axial electric field effect on the space charge wave (SCW) dynamics in multiharmonic klystron-type two-stream superheterodyne free- electron laser (TSFEL) in the framework of cubic nonlinear theory. We demonstrated that the multiharmonic SCW saturation level increases and the width of the frequency spectrum decreases in the case of a retarding electric field presence in TSFEL transit section. The saturation length also decreases in this case. The accelerating longitudinal electric field leads to the opposite effect: the width of the frequency spectrum of the multiharmonic SCW increases. We proposed the use of retarding electric fields in monochromatic TSFELs, which operate at the maximum gain mode. The use of accelerating electric field is preferable in multiharmonic TSFELs that are used to generate a powerful signal with a wide frequency spectrum.

articleTitle: The Therapeutic System Based on the Complex Effects of Low Intensity Modulated Electric Magnetic and Electromagnetic Fields
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: One of the problems of modern medicine is the development of physiotherapy devices, since pharmacotherapy, despite the high effectiveness of the application, causes harm to the body. This explains the presence of a large variety of physiotherapy devices in modern medical practice of doctors. However, there is no single approach to the choice of parameters of physiotherapeutic devices. First of all, this is due to the fact that an experimental relationship between the active dose and its effect on the body was detected. In the range between the peaks of dose density, there is practically no any therapeutic effect. Consequently, the search new methods of justification the parameters of the physical fields of informational impact is an urgent task, the solution of which will contribute to more efficient use of physiotherapy. The experimental sample of the physiotherapeutic system of complex action by modulated electric, magnetic and electromagnetic fields was created.

articleTitle: The System of Transformer Oils Laser Control by the Method of Sensing Through a Cuvette
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper represents system of transformer oils control by the method of environment laser sensing through a cuvette. Transformer oil acts as a dielectric active medium. Measurement of the indicators is based on the resonance examination of the laser beam. The method of constructing laser photometers for evaluation of transformer oils quality is considered. The use of photometers is tested on experimental stands in the production conditions of power plants (where the oils are used for heat transfer during cooling of transformers).

Author Keywords: expansion of a resonance laser beam

articleTitle: Development of Modular Reduction Based on the Divider by Blocking Negative Remainders for Critical Cryptographic Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: One of the main disadvantage of asymmetric cryptography is its low speed (in comparison with symmetric algorithms). This is very important for critical systems and applications. From this viewpoint in the paper the hardware implementation of a time-critical one of the basic operations of asymmetric cryptosystems-mod reduction is considered. Also an accelerated remainder determination method by an arbitrary modulus of number and the method implementation device based on a divider is proposed. Proposed approach of the negative remainders blocking during division without restoring the remainder is used. The mod reduction device, possessing the raised speed is developed. A step-by-step description of the operation of the device and illustrative examples are provided. The efficiency of the proposed circuit solution is verified on the Artix -7 FPGA from Xilinx for reducible numbers of different digit. Identified and presented in the form of graphs for the dependence of the spent resources of the FPGA Artix-7 on the capacity of the reducible number. Given results can be implemented in critical cryptographic applications for increasing its efficiency.

articleTitle: Generating Properties of Waves at the Resonant Frequencies of a Transparent Nonlinear Layer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: By means of example of an absolutely transparent nonlinear layer in the linear approximation (with a linear component of the dielectric permittivity being equal to one), the effect of the predominant conversion of the excitation field energy into the energy of the generated and transmitted third harmonic field is demonstrated. The resonant excitation frequency (fundamental frequency) is chosen equal to the real part of the corresponding eigenvalue of the induced spectral problem.

articleTitle: Scattering of a Plane Electromagnetic Wave by Layered Dielectric Cylinder Simulating Luneburg Lens and Dielectric Cylinder with a Graphene Coating
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We investigate the focusing effects arising in the diffraction of a plane electromagnetic wave on a piecewise homogeneous cylindrical Luneburg lens, as well as plasmon resonance in a uniform dielectric cylinder covered with a graphene layer. A numerical simulation is performed of the diffraction and scattering of a plane TE wave incident at a cylindrical stepwise uniform Luneburg lens containing six layers. A special treatment is performed for the resonance phenomena in the dielectric cylinder coated by a graphene layer. The exact classical solution is exploited for the multilayer boundary problem. For the case of a graphene coating of zero thickness, the resistive boundary conditions are applied with the conductivity of graphene introduced by Kubo equation. We show that the stratified Luneburg lens might be substituted by a uniform dielectric cylinder coated with a graphene layer operating at the plasmon resonance frequencies of graphene when it is necessary to reduce the cylinder radius to the size being equal to or even smaller than the wavelength of incident radiation.

articleTitle: Modelling and Fabrication of the Silicon-Based Device Structures for Microelectronic Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper the results of micromachining of Si wafer by various approaches are presented. The technological process based on silicon-on-insulator technology (SOI) was developed. It was shown that by choosing the topological size of the grooves, cavities and their shape, it is possible to obtain the cavities underneath the surface of Si wafer. The next procedures of deposition of polysilicon and silicon oxide films allowed to fabricate the sealed SOI cavities, which were considered as the device structures, sensitive or actuator elements. The process of Si-nanostructure fabrication through the wet chemical etching of Si wafer applicable in a wide range of applications is presented.

articleTitle: Increasing the Robustness of the Photometric Method of Ellipsometry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The technique for increasing the robustness of the photometric method of ellipsometry according to Malus law is considered. The parameters of the polarization ellipse by the ordinary least squares method and the Fourier method are calculated. The data processing procedure using the bootstrap method is described. The spread of the measured parameters of the polarization ellipses is calculated. The stability and reliability of the obtained results is appreciated. The increase in the robustness of the photometric method is confirmed.

articleTitle: The Antiradar Camouflage Method for Ground Military Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The procedure of partly coating (“camouflage”) is created for ground objects. The procedure is based on calculation method developed by authors earlier [1], [2], [3] for obtaining scattering characteristics of ground objects (possibly with radar absorbing coating). The procedure uses partly coating of object by radar absorbing material for changing (reducing) the mean radar cross-section in some aspect angle range. Selecting some object partly coating this mean value is made at most closer to mean radar cross-section of ground part which is “shadowed” by object. In this way the proposed method allows to make ground object at most inconspicuous (low-contrast”) for radars. The numerical calculations for tank model are carried out for different angle ranges and ground surface with various roughness.

articleTitle: Optical Resonances of Photonic Molecule of Twin High Refractive Index Dielectric Nanowires Excited by Modulated Electron Beam
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This work studies the optical diffraction radiation due to a modulated electron sheet beam moving between two identical dielectric nanowires, which form a photonic molecule. The electromagnetic field of such a beam induces the polarization and surface currents on the wires that radiate into the host medium. The corresponding scattering problem is treated with the aid of the azimuth Fourier expansions in local coordinates of each wire and the addition theorems for the cylindrical functions. The final matrix equation, which has mathematically guaranteed convergence, is applied to obtain spectral characteristics of diffraction radiation and visualize the field patterns. Photonic molecule of dielectric nanowires is an optical open resonator; therefore, the diffraction radiation displays the peaks on its natural mode wavelengths. Some of them appear only if the beam trajectory is shifted from symmetric position. This effect can be useful in the design of optical-range beam position monitors.

articleTitle: Influence of Pit-Type Localized Defects on the Optical Ellipsometry and Reflectometry Data: Quasi-optical Scale Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the scale modeling of the localized defects effect on the experimental data of optical ellipsometry and reflectometry using a terahertz quasi-optical ellipsometer. Defects of pit type (depression in the surface) are considered. The modeling was carried out using ferrite plates, in which pits with various geometrical parameters were made. It is shown that if the pit size is smaller than the wavelength ellipsometry does not “see” it. On the other hand, reflectometry unambiguously demonstrates a decrease in the reflectivity compared with the defect-free surface. It was also found that reflectometry is not very sensitive to the pit depth. Ellipsometry is more sensitive to the pit depth almost in all studied cases except when the size of the defect is much smaller than the wavelength.

articleTitle: Experimental Verification of a Two-Stage Bidirectional DC/DC Converter with Separated Commutation and Asymmetrical Structure of Current-Source Stage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper analyses a topology and control algorithm of an isolated bidirectional two stage DC/DC converter. The low-voltage primary stage is a voltage-source inverter (VSI) and the high-voltage secondary stage is a current-source inverter (CSI). The CSI topology is a full bridge, where the switches of the positive rail are conventional (IGBT with an antiparallel diode), while the negative rail switches are four-quadrant (anti-series connected IGBTs with antiparallel diodes). A special modulation method (separated commutation algorithm) is analysed for the energy transfer mode from the VSI to the CSI. This algorithm provides zero voltage switching (ZVS) turn-on and capacitive snubber-assisted turn-off for the VSI transistors. The CSI transistors turn-off with zero current switching (ZCS), while their turn-on is assisted by an inductive snubber. The proposed concepts are verified with simulations in MATLAB and experimental prototype. The topology is proposed for high power battery or fuel cell systems.

articleTitle: Plane-Wave Scattering by a PEC Strip Grating on Top of a Dielectric Substrate: Basic Equations, Regularization, and Convergence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We consider the scattering of a plane H-polarized wave from an infinite flat grating of perfect electrically conducting strips, placed on top of a dielectric slab. At first, we reduce this problem to a dual series equation for the complex amplitudes of the Floquet spatial harmonics. Then we perform analytical regularization of this equation, based on the inversion of the static part of the problem. This yields a Fredholm second-kind infinite matrix equation, numerical solution of which has a guaranteed convergence. We perform numerical experiments demonstrating how the rate of convergence depends on the thickness and dielectric permittivity of the slab.

articleTitle: Strain-induced Magnetoconductance in Germanium Whiskers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Germanium whiskers with gallium concentration $2\times 10^{17}\mathrm {c}\mathrm {m}^{-3}$ were chosen to investigate magnetoconductance in the range 0-14 T at 4.2 K under compressive strain up to - $2\times 10^{-3}$ rel.un. Strain influence on spin-orbital splitting on the valence band spectrum was studied. As result, the splitting of light and heavy hole branches was found under compressive strain according to kp-method. The spin splitting energy $\Delta \mathrm {s}\mathrm {o}$ as well as Rashba cubic parameter $\beta \mathrm{so}$ was found due to studying the longitudinal magnetoconductance of Ge whiskers at low temperatures.

articleTitle: optimization of Network and Scattering Parameters of Microstrip Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A rigorous electrodynamic analysis of microstrip junction using the Green function method is performed. Closed analytical formulas for components of electric field vector are derived. The unknown coefficients in respective series are determined by contemporaneous analytical and numerical integration. The values of network and scattering parameters are determined for the structures with optimal geometry and dielectric constant of substrate.

articleTitle: Structure of Information Technology and Method for Support of the Planning the Work of the Lecturer and Department of Higher Education Institution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The analysis of tools for supporting the management of the higher education institution (HEI) and its structural units showed the badness and inappropriateness of the ready tools for the planning the work of the lecturer and department of HEI, and the need of developing such a tool. The conducted modelling of the movement of information flows in the planning of the work of the HEI lecturer and in the planning the work of the department of HEI confirmed that due to the complexity, duration and routine of this work, it is necessary to develop the information technology for planning the work of HEI department. So the aim of this study is the development of the structure of information technology and method for support of the planning the work of the lecturer and department of HEI. This information technology will provide quick and easy planning of the work of HEI lecturer, and also will automate the forming of the plan of the work of the department with the calculated number of hours for each section of the department's work and with the calculated total work of the department for the academic year.

Author Keywords: planning the work of the HEI lecturer
planning the work of HEI department

articleTitle: Feed Forward Robust Control Synthesis by Discrete Continuous Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The method of multiobjective feed forward nonlinear robust control synthesis by discrete continuous plants with parametric uncertainty is developed. Synthesis of feed forward nonlinear robust controllers and nonlinear robust observers reduces to solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs equations. Robust control target vector is determined by solving the multiobjective nonlinear programming problem in which the components of the objective function vector are direct quality indicators that are imposed to the system in various modes of its operation. The calculation of the objective function vector and constraints are algorithmic and reduces to modeling of the system with nonlinear robust controllers for various modes of the system operation with different input signals and for various values of the plant parameters. The results of the dynamic characteristics modeling of a synthesized nonlinear electromechanical servo system are present.

articleTitle: Modeling of Characteristics of Distance Relay Protection of High-Voltage Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The simulation of characteristics of the directional distance protection of high-voltage power lines is realized in the PSCAD/EMTDC software complex. The comparison of the characteristics of the distance protection with the circular and polygonal tripping characteristics is conducted by means of numerical simulation. The algorithm of the fault detector is developed. Such a fault detector prevents false tripping during oscillations of the power system and asynchronous motion of generators by means of controlling the vector increase of the negative sequence currents.

articleTitle: Structural features of quenched and equilibrium Al-Ni-Zr(Hf) alloys
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The structural state of rapid quenched Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">84</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sub>Zr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sub>(Hf<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sub>) ribbons was determined by means of X-ray diffraction and SEM measurements. Each alloy consists of three compounds - Al, Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Ni and metastable Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Zr or Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Hf, respectively. The partial isothermal sections in Al-rich region of the Al-Ni-Zr(Hf) phase diagrams at 1070 K were investigated.

articleTitle: A Method of Statistical Compensation of Brightness Shifts for De-Striping of Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: One of the troubles that often arise at processing raw satellite data is the appearance of stripes on the received image. The presented paper regards the sources of the stripes and analyses some possible ways of stripes correction. A new method based on statistical compensation of brightness shifts is suggested. The suggested method does not take into account the nature of the reflecting objects, but allows fast and easy correction of striped raw data.

articleTitle: Usage of Fractal Dimension for Identification of Man-Made Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Automatic vectorization of aerospace images causes redundancy of node points of man-made objects' contours. Usage of Hough parametric space for reduction of approximation points, unlike the piecewise linear method, allows receiving more accurate representation of contours, but its computer realization is rather time-consuming. In the paper in order to reduce time and to increase efficiency of the process of vectorization of images of ultrahigh spatial resolution the possibility of usage of fractal dimension as an additional criterion for objects classification is investigated.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Hyperspectral Image Lossy Compression for Sub-band Groups
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper deals with analysis of component-wise and three-dimensional (3D) lossy compression of hyperspectral data. The latter approach is known to be more efficient due to possibility to employ inter-band correlation of images in neighbor sub-bands. However, there are certain peculiarities for this approach which are subject of our study. Methods of lossy compression that employ discrete cosine transform (DCT) in blocks are studied. It is shown that 3D compression is able to provide considerable benefits in compression ratio and/or mean square error (MSE) of introduced distortions but only under certain conditions. Experiments have been done for real-life hyperspectral data with high input signal-to-noise ratio. Their main results are presented.

articleTitle: A New Approach to No-Reference Assessment of Perceived Contrast of Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of improving the accuracy of quantifying the perceived contrast of images with a large number of objects. In this article, we propose a new approach to quantifying the perceived contrast of a multiobject image. The essence of proposed approach is in measuring the contrast of pairs of objects in a reference image with a specified range of brightness and in the follow-up correction of the measurement results taking into account the ratio of the dynamic ranges of the reference and source images. Based on this approach, proposes a generalized description for the perceived contrast of pair of objects in a multi-object image. Using this description, new definitions for the weighted and relative contrast of a pair of objects in an image are presented.

articleTitle: Generalized Stationary Michaelis—Menten Catalysis Kinetics in the Bogolyubov Reduced Description Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Generalized stationary kinetics of the Michaelis-Menten catalysis model is elaborated based on the Bogolyubov reduced description method. In this approach the system is completely described by concentration of the substrate. Effective initial conditions to obtained time equation for the substrate are calculated. Developed theory is compared with stationary Michaelis-Menten kinetics. Both theories are numerically compared with the exact theory. After a transition period there is excellent agreement of the elaborated theory with the exact theory.

Author Keywords: Bogolyubov method of the reduced description

articleTitle: Method of Forecasting the Duration of Data Transmission Routes in Mobile Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The method of forecasting the time of overloading of data transfer routes in the mobile radio link (MRL), which is constructed using the neural network of Elman based on the calculation of the potential of neurons in the network is presented. The essence of the method is to make a decision on finding new routes based on the predicted time of overloading the data transfer routes in the MRL. This method allows predicting the time of overloading of data transfer routes in the MRL due to the reduction of the computational complexity of the neural network and the application of the algorithm for training the neural network.

articleTitle: Effect of Iron Chloride Solutions on Charge Carriers’ Lifetime in Silicon Wafers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The possibility of application of silicon wafer surface treatment by iron (III) chloride solution as the instrument to determine charge carriers' lifetime is investigated. The measured lifetimes demonstrated essential growth with increase of Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions concentration. The observed effect can be further applied as the basis for heterogeneous chemical passivation of sensor array system on a single silicon wafer.

articleTitle: Spatial Structure of Focused Modes with Nonuniform Spatial Polarization of Metallic Resonator of a Terahertz Laser
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Cylindrical vector beams have many practical applications. These include material processing, electron acceleration, high-resolution metrology, microellipsometry and spectroscopy. The results of studies of the features of focusing and propagation of such beams in the terahertz range are practically absent. A theoretical study (using Rayleigh-Sommerfeld vector theory) of the physical features of the propagation of laser beams in free space with medium and sharp focus is carried out. A waveguide terahertz laser (λ = 0.4326 mm) was used as a generator. The beams were excited by the modes of the circular metal waveguide resonator for various direction polarization of the field. The results obtained complement the knowledge of laser beams focusing in the terahertz range and the peculiarities of their distribution in different diffraction zones.

articleTitle: New Technique of Social Aware Routing Protocols in Delay Tolerant Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Delay Tolerant Network (DTN) is a challenge network that can tolerate long delays during connections. It is different from traditional networks because traditional networks cannot meet the needs of disrupted and challenged networks. In this article, we will discuss the delay-tolerant network bundling protocol, which is located between the application layer and the transport layer. It is used as a communication system to meet the needs of the Internet. Delay Tolerant Network (DTN) has a coordinated, long-term and profitable surplus. Therefore, most systems use the “Transfer by Key” policy for data transfer, but the main problem with this strategy is to choose the best queue and the best commit time. Therefore, in order to solve these problems, social systems are used to delay the network. After a detailed discussion of social relationship, three routing strategies were proposed based on location, conference-based routing, and community-based approaches. We have chosen a routing strategy for three of these protocols to compare socially sensitive, ie popular routing protocols, routing protocols and spray waiting for prophets and routing protocols. These protocols are compared using a simulator based on discount rate, average latency, overload rate and hop count used. After comparison, we conclude that the spray and hold routing protocol is based on the best choice of transfer rate, overload rate and hop count.

articleTitle: Software-Hardware Complex for Measuring the Sensitivity to Color Differences Based on the Generation of Random Sequences
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This article presents the results of the development and testing of the hardware-software complex, which allows studying the color adaptation of a person's vision, determining the zones of color blindness, measuring the distances between the coordinates of the color dots representing the stimulus and environment. Numerical data are obtained on the influence of the brightness of the surrounding background on the distinctiveness of color shades. The complex has three background brightness, namely black, gray, white. Fill colors change according to normal law. The centers and radii of circles filled with opposite colors are preformed by random law.

articleTitle: Radiating Unit Based on Inverted Dielectric Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The results of the experimental research of the radiating structure, based on inverted dielectric waveguide with metal plane and periodic sequence of auxiliary partially-metallized dielectric rods, are presented. The attenuation and VSWR measurements have been carried out in a wide frequency range. The near field amplitude has been measured through the moving probe method. The radiation energy characteristics have been measured.

articleTitle: Application of Huang Transform and Wavelet Analysis for Acoustic Emission Signal Filtering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents the hybrid model of acoustic emission (AE) signal filtering on the basis of both wavelet analysis and Huang empirical mode decomposition method. We offer the technique of estimation of the wavelet filter parameters. Determination of the wavelet, level of the wavelet decomposition and value of the thresholding coefficient has been performed on the basis of the ratio of Shannon entropies which were calculated for both the allocated noise vector and filtered signal. The simulation process was carried out using acoustic emission (AE) signals which were generated during metal loading with the development of destruction from initial state to final distract with several phases.

articleTitle: The Modeling of the Lyapunov's Exponents for Incommensurate Superstructures, Which Is a Spontaneous Deformation as a Parameter of Order
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The incommensurate superstructure which is described by a two-component order parameter, the characteristic range of Lyapunov's exponents is characterized by constant positive values of the first Lyapunov’s exponent. The strongly degenerate abnormal behavior of Lyapunov's third and fourth exponents shows that the incommensurable superstructure is inherent in hyperheasis (describes the appearance of a chaotic phase) and quasi-stable state with the appearance of long-periodic proportional phases.

articleTitle: Nanostructured Ceramic-Based Sensors for Portable Electronic System of Microclimate Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The nanostructured humidity-sensitive sensors based on MgAl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> ceramics in bulk performance and temperature-sensitive multilayered thick-film sensors of different design based on semiconducting Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.6</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ni<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.9</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> ceramics were fabricated and studied. It is shown that temperature-sensitive thick-film sensors possess sensitivity in the region of 298...358 K and humidity-sensitive sensors are sensitive in the region of 30...98 %. Designed sensors were used in the portable system realized on Arduino for monitoring and control of microclimate parameters. Obtained system were tested using Android application.

articleTitle: Features of the Influence of the Team’s Delay on the Safe Landing of an Emergency Quadrocopter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: By means of mathematical modeling, the main features of safe landing of emergency quadrocopter are determined. The results of simulate landings of the quadrocopter in cases of failure of one of four pairs of electric motor screw are given. The main attention is paid to the effect of the delay on the landing command of the emergency quadrocopter in case of using the PD controller. The values of the vertical and horizontal velocities at the moment time of landing, depending on the delay time of the command to land a quadrocopter, are given.

articleTitle: Impedance Synthesis for the Ring Slotted Radiators on Hemispherical Ledges above Screen
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of impedance synthesis was solved for the linear array of ring slot radiators cut in hemispherical ledges above a perfectly conducting endless screen. It was assumed in the formulation of the problem that for the given direction of the main lobe of pattern for the monochromatic radiation of the array specified in the free half-space above the screen, it is necessary to determine the corresponding values of the complex impedances distributed on the surfaces of the hemispherical antenna elements. The analytical solution of the problem of the impedance synthesis was obtained under the condition of axially symmetric excitation of hemispherical radiators by magnetic currents of the same amplitude and the assumption that the pattern of each radiator in the array does not differ from the pattern of the isolated radiator. In order to confirm the correctness of the obtained formulas for the desired impedances the test simulation was performed for the case of a 5-element equidistant array.

articleTitle: Symmetric Ternary Wavelet Transform and Its Application in Digital Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper deals with the discrete symmetric ternary wavelet transform. It was synthesized based on two systems of wavelet functions, each is based on the respective mother wavelet. A filter bank was calculated for the synthesized transform. Application effectiveness of the synthesized transform was estimated in comparison with the existing ones using mean squared error criterion.

articleTitle: Use of Three-Step Interferometry with Arbitrary Phase Shifts for Retrieval and Monitoring of Nanoscale Rough Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A method of three-step phase shifting interferometry with arbitrary phase shifts to retrieve the nanoscale rough surfaces is proposed. The method is used for determination of the most probable starting point of a fatigue macrocrack and for study of hydrogen influence on surface relief of steel specimens.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Components of the Power of a Direct Current Motor Armature Circuit at Periodic Change of Voltage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Based on the differential equations of voltage balance for the electric circuit of the DC motor armature and the balance of torques acting on its armature, the equation of power balance was obtained. Using the trigonometric representation of the Fourier series, the equations of balance for each power harmonic at the periodic change of the armature voltage and the constant excitation flux were formed. The power components for the armature equivalent circuit inductance were analytically determined. The power components for all the elements of the armature circuit and the mechanical power were determined digitally. It is determined that in some cases the values of the power components formed by different-order harmonics essentially exceed the values of the power components formed by the same-order harmonics. It is found out by the results of the experiments that, under the condition of the action of the periodically changing armature voltage, the constant component of the angular velocity significantly influences the amplitude of the armature power oscillation. Because this constant component determines the amount of energy accumulated by the rotating masses of the armature.

articleTitle: Dielectric Wire Wrapped in Graphene Layer with a Slot as a Plasmonic Absorber of THz Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Considered is the scattering of an H-polarized plane wave by a dielectric wire with a graphene cover, which is shaped trip. We derive a hyper-singular integral equation for the electric current induced on the strip and discretize it using a Nystrom-type method. This provides the convergence of the algorithm that enables us to plot the dependences of the absorption cross-section (ACS) on the frequency, graphene strip angular width, and its orientation angle. We derive approximate characteristic equation for the frequencies of the plasmon modes as a function of the width of graphene strip. At the resonance frequencies, we control the maximum values of ACS by changing the orientation angle of the graphene strip.

articleTitle: Automation of Polymer Composite Materials Formation Process With a Specified Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The algorithm of automation systems, allowing reconcile work and extruder injection device for the introduction of intelligent sensors in specialized polymer moldings. The system allows the sensors to enter directly into the formation at the given coordinates cross-section of products with random or predetermined step. To provide a desired motion devices selected controlled vector electric drive. The results of experimental studies confirmed the possibility of implementing the algorithm of the system.

articleTitle: Analytical Solutions for Wave Process in Electrical Line with Capacitive, Inductive and Active Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The methodology for obtaining exact analytical solutions for the waveform regimes in the electric lines with loads with concentrated parameters of various types is justified. As a mathematical model the partial differential equations (telegraph equations) are used and the coefficients of these equations are presented in system of relative units. The system of equations is changed by introducing two new unknown functions, which are functions of voltage and current in the line. The mathematical relations are transformed into equations with one independent function. The new variables represent the Riemann invariants. The boundary conditions for these two functions are described by an algebraic relation and an integral- differential equation. The last equation represents the Cauchy problem for which the solutions have been determined. It was found that solutions for variables (voltage, current and Riemann invariants) are discontinuous functions. A new formulation for the boundary conditions has been proposed. It is proposed and described the process for obtaining the exact solution for the capacitance, inductive and resistive loads. The proposed method is applicable for determining voltage and current as time functions at any point of the power line. Analytical solutions can serve as test solutions for verifying precision of numerical solutions.

articleTitle: Interactive Training in English on Example of Course “Electronic Materials”
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The need to use English in modern technical education of students is obvious. In the process of interactive learning, students should be prepared for following actions: teamwork; activity in standpoint of perception, communication and sociality. Interactive training must be provided with highquality didactic material. In this case, we use our recently edited textbook for bachelors in electronics, approved and published in the USA in English, and several our textbooks for masters-level students published by us in English in Germany. Our English-language tutorials relate mainly to the field of materials used in electronic engineering..

articleTitle: Autophase Traveling Wave Tube without Resistive Coupling Jump for Operation as Amplifier and Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A novel design of autophase traveling wave tube for operation in amplification and electromagnetic energy reverse conversion modes is described. Independent supply of electromagnetic energy into bunching section and autophase section is proposed, implementation of bunching section as a section of backward wave tube is examined. This allows switching from amplification mode to reverse conversion mode simply by changing the sign of the electric field in autophase section. A version of the device with multiple energy inputs/outputs in the autophase section is also proposed. Simulation results of the proposed design are presented.
